capabilities: rename notes to their first sentence when sentence-ending punctuation appears
use a short first title line as the filename when body text follows
update wikilinks pointing to the note via fileManager.renameFile
strip characters that are invalid in filenames
extras: Also installable from the community store or by manual sideload, with instructions for Android and HarmonyOS compatibility containers; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Many note apps turn your first sentence into the file name automatically. This plugin brings that experience to Obsidian
motivation: The author wanted to bring the auto-titling behavior found in other note apps, where the first sentence becomes the file name, to Obsidian without any manual step.
problem: In Obsidian the note title is the filename, so users normally have to rename each note by hand after writing it.

relations.evidence: Install and enable BRAT from the Obsidian community plugin store.

summary: Auto-rename plugin that sets the note's filename to its first sentence or first title line whenever the note is saved.
